person_made_it: Yes for Joe specifically: the Labubu episode he is hearing right now plus Countdown, his one rave night a year with Gordon.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, openly, in every line; the closing card says it is from Gordon and built by Darby, never in Gordon's voice.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Soft morning studio light for the unboxing, then midnight on New Year's Eve.
did_the_click_pay_me: Three shakes pay off with a reveal and four tags; ten taps pay off with 2027, confetti and a crowd roar.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone-first, two big buttons, readable with sound off, tested in Safari and Chrome engines.
taught_me_something: It answers the podcast's worry in plain words: what Darby can and cannot do.
told_me_the_truth: Every tag is true per Darby's standing rules; the Countdown line only says another one is booked, which memory records.
weakest: The countdown art is generic festival, not Countdown itself; next time use a palette from his real NYE photos.
